name: dsh-reload
description: Imperative in-process reload of ONE running dsh plugin row: disposes it from the live Loader tree, evicts Node's internal ESM loadCache for the whole plugin-source graph (the @deepseek-ai/dsh-hmr recipe) and re-mounts the row at the SAME specifier, so nested relative imports re-resolve. One call, no container recreate, no service restart. Tool: 'dsh_reload'

prefix.description: Source prefix whose cached module URLs are evicted (default /var/lib/workstation/sources/).

configFile.description: Absolute path of the live config file used to resolve a row when the Loader tree has no entry (default $OMNI_DIR/config/workstation.yml, OMNI_DIR falling back to /opt/omni).
